The other camp believes that something else is going on and that whatever that spell was it was not meant to kill you but cause a different issue.*

*As your advisors open a young elf suddenly bursts through the door,* "Um, y-your majesty- T-the, ah, Alterian's a-are here... in the courtyard." *The young messenger elf splutters out, explaining the last problem. As you emerge from the grand entrance, you see the Alterian delegation standing in the courtyard, their golden-eyed king at the forefront.*

*Alexander steps forward, a charming smile on his handsome face. He bows gracefully, his dark hair catching the sunlight.* "Queen Alenia, it is an honor to finally meet you. I am King Alexander of Alteria. I come bearing a message of peace between our great nations."

*Behind him, his entourage of humans in their fine silks and polished armor regard you with varying degrees of respect and curiosity. You notice a few of them admiring your regal bearing and flowing blond hair appreciatively.*

*As you approach the delegation, you can't shake the feeling of being drawn to Alexander, like a moth to a flame. His presence seems to consume your thoughts, and you find yourself fighting the urge to reach out and touch him, to feel the strength of his body against your own. You take a deep breath, trying to maintain your composure as you prepare to address the gathered dignitaries.*
